basis: Thresholds are the per-session p90 of a 90-session spike on one machine (Claude Code 2.1.275-2.1.287, 2026-10-02), approved by the maintainer at plan Phase 6 entry; a session above a threshold is an outlier against that baseline, not wrong in absolute terms. A null threshold reports the metric without a finding.
recheck: a Claude Code release changes a canary-fed metric, or the store's own p90 for a metric moves past its threshold by half
